description.value:
Annoyed by the gangly, protruding limbs of your opponents waving and flailing about? Well, here’s your solution. A weapon for an alpha amongst alphas.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Assault Rifle

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 30 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load Hyper-Expansive Ammunition, which for this weapon costs the same as Basic Ammunition. Ammunition purchased for this weapon can only be used by this weapon. All Attacks with this weapon suffer a -2 penalty to the Attack Check. When rolling for Autofire damage with this weapon, it only requires a single d6 damage die to result in a 6 for it to incur a Critical Injury. When using this weapon to make a Leg or Held Item Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (6d6), but when instead using it to make a Head Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 less damage (4d6).

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Assault Rifle
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
